# The Botanical Bazaar LLC

> Premier Rare Tropical Plant Nursery in St. Petersburg, Florida.

## Overview
The Botanical Bazaar LLC is a specialized botanical nursery located in St. Petersburg, Florida (USDA Zone 9b/10a transition). We cultivate and curate high-end rare tropical foliage, collector aroids (Philodendron, Monstera, Anthurium, Alocasia), specimen orchids, tropical fruit trees, medicinal plants, and native Florida flora.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Botanical Catalog & Online Shop**: https://thebotanicalbazaar.com/shop
- **Horticultural Consultations**: One-on-one landscape planning, plant diagnostics, soil analysis, and lighting optimization in St. Petersburg, FL (https://thebotanicalbazaar.com/consultations).
- **The Botanical Almanac & Guides**: Seasonal monthly care guides, climate zone hardiness guidance, and species taxonomy (https://thebotanicalbazaar.com/almanac and https://thebotanicalbazaar.com/zones).

## Fulfillment Policies
- **Standard Live Plant Shipping**: Shipped directly from St. Petersburg, FL with insulated boxing, moisture barriers, heat packs for cold regions, and proactive weather holds.
- **Local Nursery Pickup**: Free pickup ($0.00) available by appointment at our nursery in St. Petersburg, FL.
